title: Pure Icejade
summary: Icejade cards with generic WATER Synchro and Xyz monsters and staples. Icejade is a WATER Aqua control strategy that locks opposing monsters with Icejade Cenote Enion Cradle and Icejade Curse while floating from the GY whenever a WATER monster is destroyed.

summary.title: Starters
points: Icejade Cradle searches any Icejade monster with a different name from the monsters you control or in your GY, with no once-per-turn limit.

Icejade Aegirine adds any Icejade Spell/Trap from the Deck to the hand on Normal or Special Summon, and when targeted for an attack or effect, protects itself and summons a WATER monster from your hand or GY.
Icejade Ran Aegirine discards 1 other Icejade card or WATER monster to Special Summon itself from the hand along with a Level 3 Icejade Token, immediately setting up a Level 10 WATER Synchro Summon.

summary.title: Opening: Icejade Aegirine or Icejade Ran Aegirine
steps: Normal Summon Icejade Aegirine to search Icejade Cradle (or Icejade Cenote Enion Cradle), then use Cradle to search Icejade Ran Aegirine.
Discard a WATER monster or Icejade card to Special Summon Icejade Ran Aegirine and a Level 3 Icejade Token (locking your Extra Deck to WATER monsters while the Token is on the field).
Tune Level 7 Ran Aegirine and the Level 3 Token into Level 10 Icejade Gymir Aegirine alongside Aegirine and your Field Spell.

summary.title: Graveyard Float Loop & Equip Creation
summary.text: Icejade Acti, Icejade Tinola, and Icejade Tremora all share a GY trigger: when a face-up WATER monster you control is destroyed by battle or card effect, you can banish one of them from your GY to Special Summon an Icejade monster from your hand or GY. Icejade Creation Aegirocassis and Icejade Creation Kingfisher equip from the hand or GY to an Icejade to boost stats or bounce opposing monsters, and while equipped to a monster, Icejade Ran Aegirine's name becomes Icejade Cenote Enion Cradle to turn on the Kosmochlor and Curse lock.

summary.title: Bosses & Control Lock
points: Icejade Gymir Aegirine activates as a Quick Effect to make face-up monsters you control immune to destruction and banishment by your opponent's card effects for the turn; if activated in response to an opponent's card or effect, it banishes all cards with that name from their field and GY.

While Icejade Cenote Enion Cradle and an Icejade monster are on the field, Icejade Curse prevents your opponent's monsters from activating their effects the turn they are Summoned, and Icejade Kosmochlor prevents them from activating effects except the turn they are Summoned—together locking out all on-field monster activations.
Icejade Cenote Enion Cradle reduces the ATK of all monsters your opponent controls by the original ATK of a monster when a monster is Normal or Special Summoned.

Icejade Erosion destroys an Icejade you control to permanently negate a face-up card's effects, and summons or adds an Icejade from the Deck whenever a WATER monster leaves your field by an opponent's card.
